we profiled peripheral blood immune cells from 64 patients with COVID-19 and 12 healthy controls with three high-dimensional single-cell modalities: Seq-Well (Gierahn et al., 2017; Hughes et al., 2020)-based scRNA-seq (33 patients and 8 controls, including 7 patients previously profiled by our group; Wilk et al., 2020), scATAC-seq (18 patients, 7 controls), and CyTOF (64 patients, 12 controls; Fig. 1 A and Fig. S1).

we profiled peripheral blood immune cells from 64 patients with COVID-19 and 12 healthy controls with three high-dimensional single-cell modalities: Seq-Well (Gierahn et al., 2017; Hughes et al., 2020)-based scRNA-seq (33 patients and 8 controls, including 7 patients previously profiled by our group; Wilk et al., 2020), scATAC-seq (18 patients, 7 controls), and CyTOF (64 patients, 12 controls; Fig. 1 A and Fig. S1).
Hi-C data for monocytes was taken from Phanstiel et al. (2017), downloaded using Juicer-Tools version 1.22 (Durand et al., 2016).
Eligibility criteria included age ≥18 yr and a positive SARS-CoV-2 nasopharyngeal swab by RT-PCR.
